abstract: A 45-year-old male patient, with no history of interest, consulted in emergency department due to a progressive loss of strength in the lower limbs at the distal level with impossibility for dorsal flexion of the left foot, as well as neurogenic bladder. The MRI revealed a mass at the filum terminale with completed occupation of transverse diameter of the dural sac. The radiological diagnosis was lipoma of filum terminale. The patient underwent surgery with intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring using direct stimulation of nerve roots, which allowed the removal of a tumour composed of sebaceous material, fat and hair. The anatomopathological study classified it as a mature cystic teratoma. Postoperative evolution was favorable.
abstract_ja: 既往歴のない45歳男性が、左足の背屈不能を伴う遠位下肢の進行性筋力低下と神経因性膀胱のため救急外来を受診した。MRIでは、硬膜嚢の横径を完全に占拠する終糸の腫瘤が認められた。放射線学的診断は終糸脂肪腫であった。患者は神経根の直接刺激を用いた術中神経生理学的モニタリング下で手術を受け、皮脂性物質、脂肪、毛髪からなる腫瘍を摘出した。病理学的検査では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と分類された。術後経過は良好であった。
